lines.zh: 拖着重甲挪步，路面都跟着发颤。
lines.en: Dragging this heavy armor, even the road trembles.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩得结结实实，稳得很。
lines.en: Every step lands firm and solid.

lines.zh: 别看走得慢，方向可一点不含糊。
lines.en: Slow as I am, my direction is never vague.

lines.zh: 铁靴碾过碎石子，咯吱作响。
lines.en: Iron boots grind the gravel with a crunch.

lines.zh: 巡逻路线我熟，闭着眼都能走。
lines.en: I know the patrol route; I could walk it blindfolded.

lines.zh: 这身板沉，走起来倒不觉得累。
lines.en: This body is heavy, yet walking tires me little.

lines.zh: 影子拉得老长，我继续往前。
lines.en: My shadow stretches long; I keep moving.

lines.zh: 走两步歇一步？那是别人。
lines.en: Rest every other step? That's others, not me.

lines.zh: 风吹过来，我连眼皮都不抬。
lines.en: Wind blows past; I don't even lift an eyelid.

lines.zh: 该去那边转转了，脚步不停。
lines.en: Time to check over there; my feet don't stop.

lines.zh: 地面再硬，也硬不过我的鞋底。
lines.en: The ground is hard, but not harder than my soles.

lines.zh: 慢慢走，反正没什么能拦住我。
lines.en: Walking slow; nothing can really stop me.

lines.zh: 拐过这个弯，视野就开阔了。
lines.en: Round this bend, the view opens up.

lines.zh: 站久了腿发僵，动一动正好。
lines.en: Standing stiffens my legs; moving suits me fine.

lines.zh: 站着不动，正好听听四周动静。
lines.en: Standing still, I listen to the surroundings.

lines.zh: 靠着这堵墙歇一会儿，就一会儿。
lines.en: I'll rest against this wall—just for a moment.

lines.zh: 没人过来，我也懒得挪窝。
lines.en: No one's coming; I can't be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 呼吸放慢，铁甲也跟着安静。
lines.en: Breathing slows; the iron armor quiets too.

lines.zh: 眼皮有点沉，但耳朵还竖着。
lines.en: My eyelids droop, but my ears stay up.

lines.zh: 这地方安静得让人犯困。
lines.en: This place is quiet enough to make me drowsy.

lines.zh: 手里没活，就站着发会儿呆。
lines.en: Nothing to do, so I stand and stare awhile.

lines.zh: 风从盔甲缝里钻进来，凉飕飕。
lines.en: Wind slips through my armor seams, chilly.

lines.zh: 不急着走，先让脚底缓一缓。
lines.en: No rush to move; let my soles recover.

lines.zh: 远处有动静吗？再听仔细点。
lines.en: Movement far off? Let me listen closer.
Just standing here suits me fine.

lines.zh: 肩膀松下来，重甲也没那么沉。
lines.en: Shoulders relax; the heavy armor feels lighter.

lines.zh: 天色还早，不用急着赶路。
lines.en: Still early; no need to hurry on.
When I've rested enough I'll move; don't rush me.
You've stood there a while—something up?
Don't circle around; just say it.

lines.zh: 你身上没带什么危险玩意吧？
lines.en: You're not carrying anything dangerous, are you?

lines.zh: 我认得你的脚步声，新来的。
lines.en: I know your footsteps—you're new.

lines.zh: 盯着我看，是想比谁先眨眼？
lines.en: Staring at me—want to see who blinks first?

lines.zh: 你这身打扮，不像本地人。
lines.en: The way you dress, you're not from here.
Speak up; my ears work fine.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，我块头大，容易碰着。
lines.en: Don't get too close; I'm bulky and might bump you.

lines.zh: 你手放哪儿呢，我看得见。
lines.en: I can see where your hands are.

lines.zh: 想打听路？先说说你要去哪。
lines.en: Need directions? First tell me where you're headed.

lines.zh: 你这眼神，像在盘算什么。
lines.en: That look in your eyes—like you're scheming.

lines.zh: 我不主动惹事，但也不怕事。
lines.en: I don't start trouble, but I don't fear it either.
Talk from a distance; I hear you fine.
You're breathing hard—run a long way?

lines.zh: 别在我面前耍花样，我看得懂。
lines.en: Don't try tricks in front of me; I can read them.
You've got the scent of a stranger.

lines.zh: 我这儿没什么好瞧的，说正事。
lines.en: Nothing to see here; get to the point.

lines.zh: 你再靠近一步，我可要动了。
lines.en: One more step closer, and I'll move.

lines.zh: 看你样子，不像来找茬的。
lines.en: You don't look like you're here for a fight.
Fine, I'm listening—take your time.
My hide is split, but the iron plates still hang on.

lines.zh: 铁甲挡了不少，可还是疼。
lines.en: The armor took most of it, but it still hurts.
Who hit me? Don't hide.
Took a hit; I'll remember it.
Hitting me doesn't pay; you should know.
Hurts, but I'm still standing.
This wound just needs a moment.
Try another one?
Don't crowd me while I recover.
I'm thick-skinned, but I do get angry.

lines.zh: 食物？你怕是找错对象了。
lines.en: Food? You've got the wrong one.
I'm not hungry; stop waving that around.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，这招对我没用。
lines.en: Put it away; that trick won't work on me.

lines.zh: 我又不是牲口，拿吃的勾我？
lines.en: I'm no livestock—luring me with food?

lines.zh: 你那点东西，留着自个儿吃。
lines.en: Keep your scraps for yourself.

lines.zh: 我站这儿不是等投喂的。
lines.en: I'm not standing here waiting to be fed.

lines.zh: 闻着是不错，可惜我不动心。
lines.en: Smells fine, but I'm not swayed.
Stop holding it up; I'm not blind.

lines.zh: 想用吃的换我听话？省省。
lines.en: Trade food for my obedience? Save it.
Wave it again and I'll take it as a challenge.
Hey, watch where you're going!
Bump into me and don't you cry about it.
This frame of mine isn't light.
You all right? Steady yourself.
Walking with momentum still needs direction.

lines.zh: 碰一下罢了，别大惊小怪。
lines.en: Just a bump; don't make a fuss.
Go around next time, saves us both pain.
Your steps are too hasty.

lines.zh: 我站这儿没动，是你撞上来的。
lines.en: I stood still; you're the one who ran into me.
Brush off the dust and we go our ways.
Don't bring that up; I've no interest.
Find someone else; I just keep watch.
We don't have that kind of bond.
Don't lean in so close; back off.
That's crossing a line.
Patrol and iron armor are all I know.
Cut that out; I'm not buying it.
Stand straight and talk; don't lean in.

lines.zh: 你再这样，我可要动手了。
lines.en: Keep this up and I'll get rough.
Save the effort; let's mind our own business.

lines.zh: 这玩意儿归我了，别伸手。
lines.en: This thing's mine now; hands off.

lines.zh: 弯腰捡东西，铁甲咯吱响。
lines.en: Bending to pick it up, my armor creaks.

lines.zh: 地上掉的，总得有人收着。
lines.en: Something dropped; someone ought to keep it.
Pick it up and look—it's heavy.
Don't think I'm giving it back to anyone.
Pick it up and stow it, so it won't trip anyone.
Who dropped this? It's mine now.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一放，我就归你了。
lines.en: Drop the spawn egg and I'm yours.
Tuck it away and get back to work.

lines.zh: 地上有东西，我可不会装没看见。
lines.en: Something's on the ground; I won't pretend otherwise.

lines.zh: 哈斯克被唤醒，听我号令。
lines.en: The husk is woken and follows my call.
You're the one; hold it.
Movement over there; I've got my eye on it.
Stop hiding; I see you.
Target locked; keep moving.
Your size gives you away.

lines.zh: 想从这儿过去？先过我这关。
lines.en: Trying to pass here? Get through me first.
Someone's looking for trouble—good.

lines.zh: 别回头张望，说的就是你。
lines.en: Don't look around; I mean you.
Once I fix on someone, they don't get away.
Don't circle; it won't help.
My heavy hooves paw the dirt, breath on your boots.
Breathing that hard—tired from running?

lines.zh: 我慢慢跟，反正你甩不掉。
lines.en: I follow slowly; you can't shake me.
Behind that pillar? I can see you.
One more step back and it's a wall.
Your steps are getting sloppy.
I'm bulky, but my eyes work fine.

lines.zh: 别东张西望，就我一个追你。
lines.en: Don't look around; I'm the only one after you.

lines.zh: 你跑不了多远，省点力气。
lines.en: You won't get far; save your strength.
Take a heavy fist from me!
My tusks scrape the edge of your armor.
This one's gonna hurt.
Brace yourself; don't get knocked away.
Iron armor and a fist—plenty of weight.

lines.zh: 你躲得了一次，躲不了两次。
lines.en: Dodge once, but not twice.
Here comes the fist—catch it.
Running into me brings no good.
Another hit—can you take it?
Take the hit and quit; don't push it.

lines.zh: 从哪儿冒出来的？反正我到了。
lines.en: Where did I pop out from? Anyway, I'm here.
With a clank of armor, I take my stand.

lines.zh: 这地方，看来得由我守着。
lines.en: Looks like I'm the one guarding this place.
Get my footing and take a look around.
I'm here—don't expect me to be gentle.

lines.zh: 谁把我弄来的？算了，干活。
lines.en: Who brought me here? Never mind—to work.
Landed heavy; the ground shook.
New place, new faces—I'll remember them.
Standing ready; this area's mine to watch.
Just got my footing; don't come provoking me yet.

lines.zh: 火燎得盔甲发烫，离远点。
lines.en: The flames heat my armor; stay back.

lines.zh: 高处摔下来，脚底震得发麻。
lines.en: Fell from a height; my soles are numb.

lines.zh: 水里憋得难受，我得上去。
lines.en: Hard to hold my breath down here; I need air.

lines.zh: 我的兽皮被炸开一道口子。
lines.en: The blast tore a gash in my hide.

lines.zh: 哪儿飞来的东西？找掩护。
lines.en: Where did that come from? Take cover.

lines.zh: 这邪门玩意，盔甲可挡不住。
lines.en: This strange stuff—my armor can't block it.
My stomach's empty and uneasy; I must hold on.
Lightning struck; my whole body went numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没底，这地方不对劲。
lines.en: No ground beneath me; this place is wrong.
